title: Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.14051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reusing key--value (KV) caches across language model updates could avoid repeated computation of shared context, but changes in model weights raise a fundamental question about what these caches preserve. We investigate direct cache reuse across four model updates, with a detailed study of DeepSeek-V4-Flash to Flash-0731. Our central finding is that caches can retain useful task information without faithfully reproducing the updated model's behavior. Retrieval accuracy varies substantially across updates, ranging from near-native performance to large losses. With source caches already available, reuse achieves median time-to-first-token speedups of $2.10$--$5.08\times$ on three longer-prefix QA benchmarks. To characterize the behavioral differences behind these outcomes, we introduce Functional Cache Divergence, which compares next-token distributions under reused and native caches. translated_title: KV缓存能否在模型更新之间复用？一项基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash的案例研究
translated_abstract: 在语言模型更新之间复用键值（KV）缓存可以避免对共享上下文的重复计算，但模型权重的变化引出了一个根本性问题：这些缓存究竟保留了什么。我们研究了跨四个模型更新的直接缓存复用，并对DeepSeek-V4-Flash到Flash-0731的更新进行了详细研究。我们的核心发现是：缓存可以在不忠实复现更新后模型行为的情况下，仍保留有用的任务信息。检索准确率在不同更新之间差异巨大，从接近原生模型的性能到大幅性能损失不等。在源缓存已可用的情况下，复用在三个更长前缀的问答基准上实现了中位数首词生成时间2.10至5.08倍的加速。为了刻画这些结果背后的行为差异，我们提出了函数性缓存偏差，用于比较复用缓存与原生缓存下的下一词元分布。直接KV缓存复用能更好地保留原生模型行为……
tldr: 该研究首次系统探索了KV缓存在模型更新间的直接复用，发现缓存可保留任务信息并带来最高5.08倍的首词生成加速，但复用缓存并不忠实复现新模型行为，为此提出了函数性缓存偏差（Functional Cache Divergence）来量化这种行为差异。
en_tdlr: This study is the first to systematically explore direct KV cache reuse across model updates, showing that caches retain task information and achieve up to 5.08× time-to-first-token speedups while introducing Functional Cache Divergence to quantify that reused caches do not faithfully reproduce the updated model's behavior.
